elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Although subsection (a) prohibits such payments by the Company, subsection (c) still provides that a Termination Payment, “if any,” shall be payable by the Company, creating a direct operative contradiction.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) retains a Company-payable Termination Payment without limiting it to early termination.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: No three-month fee cap appears in the rendered language.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause does not establish a capped early-termination fee as the sole liquidated amount, and subsection (c) retains a potentially payable Termination Payment.
